assertion.text: An exhaustive bounded search of the 15 primes in the inclusive range 10430601..10430800 found no k=15 witness; the maximum multiplicity observed was 11 at p=10430729, residue 5661996.

conditions: Caveat: This is a bounded negative result for the exact retained range, algorithm, artifact, and verifier. It does not establish universal nonexistence, resolve Erdős problem 1056, or change scientific Standing.
